name: Hua Jung Components Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hua Jung Components Co.,Ltd., a Taiwanese enterprise, specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of film capacitors within Taiwan. Their comprehensive product portfolio encompasses various capacitor types, such as metallized polyester, metallized polypropylene, power film, and EMI suppression models. The company also offers products related to technology exchange. Primarily serving clients in the power supply and lighting sectors, Hua Jung Components was established in 1983 and maintains its headquarters in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
